title: Chemically Competent Cells
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7jwhkpe
materials: Grow to OD600 0.6 in 0.1/10 mL LB.

steps.title: Overnight culture
steps.instruction: Culture the desired strain overnight in LB using 0.5 mL inoculum per 50 mL LB in a Greiner tube.

steps.title: Harvest cells
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the overnight culture at 8000 rpm for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Resuspend pellet in CaCl2
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet in 5 mL ice‑cold CaCl₂ solution.

steps.title: Aliquot and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Dispense 1.5 mL of the suspension into each of three Eppendorf tubes and centrifuge at 8000 rpm for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Resuspend in small volume
steps.instruction: Resuspend each pellet in 0.5 mL ice‑cold CaCl₂, gently flicking the tube to mix.

steps.title: Aliquot and freeze
steps.instruction: Aliquot the cell suspension into 50 µL cryogenic tubes and store at –80 °C until transformation.
